name: freight-quote
title: Freight quotation for review
for_each: select id,code from quotes order by code

sections.title: Services
sections.sql: select description,quantity from quote_lines where quote_id=$1 order by created_at,id

sections.title: Price
sections.sql: select currency,net_cents,tax_cents,total_cents from quote_totals where id=$1
sections.note: Review validity, charge coverage and tax treatment before use. Nothing has been sent.

name: pricing-worksheet
title: Internal pricing worksheet
for_each: select id,code from quotes order by code

sections.title: Cost evidence
sections.sql: select description,quantity,unit_buy_cents,source_valid_to,source_ref from quote_lines where quote_id=$1 order by created_at,id
sections.note: Internal only. Do not send this working paper to the customer.
